Test fixtures. The field names and nesting are copied from the live APIs (checked 4 Nov 2026):
CPSC `RestWebServices/Recall`, NHTSA vPIC `GetModelsForMakeYear` and `DecodeVinValues`, and
NHTSA `recalls/recallsByVehicle`. The CPSC companies, products and recalls are made up, so the
tests can't be mistaken for statements about real products. The vehicle fixtures use the
standard example VIN 1HGCM82633A004352 (a 2003 Honda Accord); the model IDs and all recall text in them are made up.
